current_activity: Clipper: attacks Geilenkirchen and the villages on the Wurm with the US 84th Division under command
notes: Event date: 18 November 1944 (Ellis, vol. II, pp. 161, 162). Event definition: On 18 November, two days after the American XIX Corps attacks towards Julich and Linnich, XXX Corps attacks Geilenkirchen and a string of villages astride the Wurm river about three miles further east; the United States 84th Division (temporarily under the corps) attacks on the right with British flail and gun tanks and is through the Siegfried Line pill-boxes by midday, and the 43rd Division then attacks on its left; some 800 prisoners are taken on the first day and Geilenkirchen is captured the next day after a stiff fight (pp. 161-162).
